scripts.text:
[Auction Hall Guide]
Hello, would you
like to enter the
Auction Hall?
scripts.translation:
[拍賣行嚮導]
你好，想進入拍賣行嗎？

scripts.text:
[Auction Hall Guide]
Great! Well then,
I hope you have fun
and enjoy the auction~
scripts.translation:
[拍賣行嚮導]
太好了！
祝你玩得開心，盡情享受拍賣的樂趣吧~

[拍賣行嚮導]
祝你拍賣愉快。

scripts.text:
[Auction Hall Guide]
Alright then,
see you later.
If you change your
mind, please come
and enjoy the auctions~
scripts.translation:
[拍賣行嚮導]
好，那下次見。
如果改變主意，隨時來參加拍賣哦~

scripts.text:
[Auction Broker]
Welcome to the Auction Hall.
Would you like to view the goods?
scripts.translation:
[拍賣經紀人]
歡迎來到拍賣行。
想看看拍賣品嗎？

scripts.text:
[Auction Broker]
Very well.
Please take
a look, and see
What's being offered~
scripts.translation:
[拍賣經紀人]
好。
請看看都有哪些拍賣品吧~

scripts.text:
[Auction Broker]
Very well, then.
If you change your
mind, then please
come and check
out the auctions~
scripts.translation:
[拍賣經紀人]
好吧。
如果改變主意，隨時來看看拍賣品哦~
